subject: PO requirements, invoice cutoff & discount slab qualification for Crescent Health
messages:
From: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@crescenthealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Brooks <t.brooks@crescenthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO template + invoicing cadence questions for Redwood SOW

Hi Marissa / Vanessa,

Thanks for the SOW draft — Crescent is ready to move forward but procurement has two items they want clarified before we issue the blanket PO:

1) PO line mapping: Our ERP requires each invoice to reference a PO line number that maps to an internal cost center. Can Redwood accept separate invoices per PO line, or do you prefer a consolidated monthly invoice with PO-line detail on each line?

2) Invoice cutoffs: We run a month-end close and need invoices submitted by the 20th of the following month for payment processing. Is Redwood able to align invoice periods to a 20th cutoff? Our standard payment terms are net45 after invoice receipt.

3) Discount slab qualification: Procurement is requesting the 15% usage discount be applied only after a committed monthly minimum (1.2M token equivalent). They also want a clear measurement window and reconciliation process. How does Redwood measure usage for tiering and how quickly can credits/adjustments be applied?

I've attached our PO template and your billing guidelines. Can you confirm the approach so we can route the PO to legal/finance?

Thanks,
Angela Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager
Crescent Health Systems

Attachments: Crescent_PO_Template.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO template + invoicing cadence questions for Redwood SOW

Hi Angela — thanks for the clear list and the template. Quick answers up front, then a proposed path: 

1) PO line mapping: We can do either, but prefer a consolidated monthly invoice that contains a line-item breakdown per PO line (ERP-friendly CSV attached as an example). If Crescent insists on separate invoice files per PO line, we can support that as an exception (small processing fee may apply depending on number of lines).

2) Invoice cutoff: We can align to a 20th cutoff for billing period close — that works. Our standard hosted customers use the last calendar day, but we have flexibility for enterprise POs. Confirming net45 is acceptable on our side. If you need faster payment terms tied to an early-pay discount, we can discuss separately.

3) Discount slab measurement: Redwood measures usage at the token level (generation + input tokens) computed daily and summarized monthly. For the 15% slab at 1.2M tokens/month, we propose:
   - Measurement window: calendar month aligning to your 20th cutoff (we will prorate month boundaries to match).
   - Reconciliation: usage report (CSV) will be provided with each invoice; if the committed threshold is hit, the discount will be applied on the next invoice cycle as a credit.

Proposal (to expedite PO):
- Crescent issues a blanket PO referencing Contract RDW-8374 and the SOW.
- Bill monthly with 20th cutoff; invoices issued within 3 business days after cutoff.
- If multiple PO lines exist, Redwood will include PO-line mapping on the consolidated invoice; we can provide separate invoice files if required (let us know count).
- Discount triggers applied as credits on the following invoice with supporting usage report.

I'll loop Priya (billing) and Vanessa (pricing) to confirm edge cases (large number of PO lines, retro credits).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Angela — Vanessa here from Pricing Ops. A couple of clarifications from our side to avoid surprises during the reconciliation: 

- Discount lookback: we apply the slab prospectively once the monthly threshold is exceeded and credit retroactively for that month only. We do not re-price prior closed months.

- Tier granularity: if Crescent wants the 15% to apply at the customer account level across multiple legal entities, please confirm the exact BU/PO lines to aggregate. Aggregation rules need to be in the PO or an attached appendix; otherwise we treat each PO as an independent billing entity.

- PO line volume: if you have >25 PO lines per invoice, our finance team will request a small setup fee to map and validate lines automatically. For most enterprise deals we keep PO line count <=12 to avoid this.

Operational suggestion: Put a brief clause in the PO that says: 
   "Redwood will provide a consolidated monthly invoice referencing PO <number> with line-item mapping to Crescent cost centers; discount eligibility will be measured monthly and credited on the subsequent invoice."

If that language is acceptable, legal can proceed and we can get the PO issued.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Pricing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@crescenthealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO template + invoicing cadence questions for Redwood SOW

Thanks team — Priya from Billing. A few operational details so your AP can map invoices without manual work: 

- File format: We will attach a machine-readable CSV with each PDF invoice. The CSV includes columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, po_line, cost_center, description, quantity_tokens, unit_price, line_total.

- Cutoff implementation: With your 20th cutoff we will run usage aggregation on the 21st, generate reports on the 22nd, and issue the consolidated invoice by EOD 23rd. That leaves your AP two business days to ingest before your internal 25th review if desired.

- Credits: If a discount triggers for the month, the credit will appear as a separate line item labeled "Usage Credit - Month YYYY-MM" on the subsequent invoice. If you prefer immediate billing with a negative line on the same invoice, we can do that but it requires an updated PO note allowing negative invoice lines.

- Statement of work acceptance (invoices tied to milestones): For onboarding professional services that are milestone-billed, we need the PO to reference the milestone schedule and acceptance criteria. For hosted usage we treat billing as usage-based and not milestone contingent. If Crescent wants onboarding fees held until formal acceptance, indicate which milestones correspond to invoice numbers in the PO.

Happy to share a sample invoice + CSV before your PO is finalized.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Billing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: Redwood_Billing_Guidelines.xlsx

Marissa / Vanessa / Priya — this is very helpful, thank you. Two quick follow-ups from Crescent: 

1) We will include the clause you suggested in the PO. Please confirm you will accept a single PO number that covers both hosted usage and the one-time onboarding professional services. We will map onboarding milestone invoice numbers on the PO appendix.

2) For credits, Crescent prefers the credit on the subsequent invoice as a separate line item (keeps our ledger clean).

If you can send the sample consolidated invoice + CSV (as Priya suggested) we will attach it to the PO as an example for our AP. Once we have that, I will route the PO to Legal and Finance.

Best,
Angela Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager
Crescent Health Systems
